CREATE VIEW customer_orders AS
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS paid_cents
FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
SELECT * FROM customer_orders ORDER BY customer_id;

       outer_score.subject,
       outer_score.score
FROM demo_scores AS outer_score
WHERE outer_score.score > (
  SELECT AVG(inner_score.score)
  FROM demo_scores AS inner_score
  WHERE inner_score.subject = outer_score.subject

  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  subject TEXT,
  day TEXT,
  minutes INTEGER
);
INSERT INTO demo_practice VALUES
  (1, 'Art', '2026-01-01', 10),
  (2, 'Art', '2026-01-02', 25),
  (3, 'Art', '2026-01-03', 25),

SELECT subject, day, minutes,
  SUM(minutes) OVER (
    PARTITION BY subject
    ORDER BY day, id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_total
FROM demo_practice
ORDER BY subject, day, id;

SELECT subject, day, minutes,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY subject
    ORDER BY minutes DESC
  ) AS duration_rank
FROM demo_practice
ORDER BY subject, day, id;
